name: Connectors
description: Browse a comprehensive selection of connectors, headers, sockets, terminal blocks, cables, adapters, and interconnect solutions designed to provide secure and reliable electrical connections.

name: Embedded Solutions
description: Find embedded development boards, microcontrollers, single-board computers, evaluation kits, and accessories for designing, prototyping, and deploying intelligent embedded applications.

name: Optoelectronics
description: Discover LEDs, displays, OLEDs, LCDs, infrared devices, lasers, photodiodes, optocouplers, and other optoelectronic components for lighting, display, sensing, and optical communication applications.

name: Power
description: Explore power supplies, batteries, chargers, DC-DC converters, AC-DC modules, voltage regulators, and power management solutions for powering electronic devices efficiently and safely.

name: Semiconductors
description: Explore semiconductors including microcontrollers, ICs, transistors, diodes, voltage regulators, MOSFETs, and logic devices. These components form the foundation of modern electronic circuits and embedded systems.

name: Sensors
description: Discover a wide range of sensors for measuring temperature, humidity, pressure, motion, light, gas, distance, and other environmental parameters. Ideal for IoT, automation, robotics, and industrial monitoring applications.
